purpose: Discuss diplomacy; teach 圧力/延長/行なわ/意義/払っ/あえて/そうすると/いわば

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国際会議で、各国の圧力が強まっています。
lines.en: At the international conference, countries’ pressure is mounting.
lines.style: measured teacher framing, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 議論の期限が、再び延長されました。
lines.en: The debate’s deadline was extended again.
lines.style: student updating, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 投票は、来週行なわれる予定です。
lines.en: The vote will be conducted next week.
lines.style: attentive teen reporting, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今回の会議には、意義があると言えます。
lines.en: You could say this conference has significance.
lines.style: teacher offering analysis, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 各国とも、細部まで注意を払っています。
lines.en: Every country is paying attention to details.
lines.style: student noting care, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生は、あえて批判的な視点も大事だと？
lines.en: You think a deliberately critical view matters too?
lines.style: teen pressing the teacher, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうすると、議論が深まりますからね。
lines.style: teacher affirming, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いわば、自国の利害を超えた対話、ですね。
lines.en: So to speak, a dialogue beyond national interest.
lines.style: student synthesizing, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence
